inserts.afterExact: LEGOLAND Malaysia is located in Medini, Nusajaya (Iskandar Puteri), Johor — approximately 20–30 km west of JB city centre. Travel time from JB Sentral or Taman Pelangi by Grab is around 25–35 minutes and costs approximately RM25–40 one-way. The park is also accessible from Singapore via the Tuas Second Link (Second Causeway) — the LEGOLAND Malaysia Hotel offers a dedicated shuttle service from Singapore.

The most iconic feature of any LEGOLAND — a scaled recreation of Asian landmarks built from over 30 million LEGO bricks. The Asian MINILAND includes models of iconic structures from across Southeast and East Asia: KL's Petronas Towers, Singapore's Marina Bay Sands, Bangkok's temples, and more. Impressive in scale and detail, and the best photography location in the park.

officialSection:
Official Information

  • Address: 7 Jalan LEGOLAND, Bandar Medini Iskandar Malaysia, 79250 Iskandar Puteri (Nusajaya), Johor. LEGOLAND Malaysia Resort
  • Tickets: the official site advertises a Day Ticket from RM69 when booked online, and a Water Park special at RM88. Prices change with dates and promotions, so check the live price before you go. LEGOLAND Malaysia Resort
  • Hours: the official calendar shows different times by day. On 1 October 2026 it listed the Theme Park 11 am – 8 pm (last entry 7 pm), the Water Park 10 am – 6 pm, and SEA LIFE 10 am – 6 pm (last entry 5 pm); the next day the Theme Park was 10 am – 9 pm. LEGOLAND Malaysia opening hours
  • Size: the theme park has 8 themed lands and 40+ rides, shows and attractions; the Water Park has 20+ slides, rides and water play areas. LEGOLAND Malaysia Resort

Details above were checked on LEGOLAND Malaysia's official site on 1 October 2026; opening times and prices change, so always confirm before you travel.
